title: Infotainment setup and usability
summary: Feedback on the infotainment topic combines clear praise for system quality and ease of setup with many excerpts whose sentiment labels remain undetermined despite mentioning both strengths and letdowns.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the infotainment as excellent, very good, easy to set up, and simple to use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mention conflicting infotainment impressions including flawless operation, broad usability, complexity, processor issues, unfinished software, and statements of letdown.

limitations: Most sampled excerpts in this topic are labeled undetermined, which limits sentiment-specific conclusions.
Some undetermined fragments express seemingly clear opinions, so the available labels do not fully resolve the direction of sentiment.
One fragment is too vague to interpret confidently because it only says '6 was a letdown'.
